intro: Overlord Mok'Morokk of the Stonemaul clan is in Brackenwall Village and wants his grog, snuff and strongbox back. He left them behind in a hurry at the clan's old home, and he sends you south to find them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rexxar make me mighty leader of Stonemaul Clan!
Me good leader. Me keep clan safe.
Big dragons come and make fire at old home. Me smart ogre. Find new home for clan here.

Leave old home so fast, me forget stuff. Tiny traveler, go get my things. Go south and find my yummy grog, my snuff and my strongbox. Me like you after you do that. You look in Den of Flame and Stonemaul Ruins... They be there, me sure!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Me thirsty for grog. Me miss snuff too. Where is strongbox? You go get for Overlord Mok'Morokk.
Go find south in old home. Me too busy leading ogres to get.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You good traveler. Me miss things very much. Me like you now.
